description: A screen-time card with 24 hourly bars, a total in the header and a dashed average line.
overview: Thin bars show minutes for each hour of the day, with ticks every six hours and a value axis in minutes on the right. A `ReferenceLine` marks the hourly average, and the header shows the day's total in hours and minutes. The tooltip formats the hour and the minutes.
usage: Replace the 24 values in `chartData` with your hourly minutes; the total and average are calculated from it. The component takes no props.
